the_rebase_crossed_rewrite_work_never_ev.detail: It did not, and the builder's reading of the prohibition is correct. contracts/repository-candidate-lifecycle.json lists 'rebase-onto-current-target' under rewrite_policy.mutable_allowed, and 'rebase' under frozen_forbidden. sov_candidate.py judge grades RECONCILE from MUTABLE with code null and from FROZEN with INVALID_STATE. No rule was broken.

the_rebase_was_therefore_without_cost.detail: The same contract declares the cost in the same object. operations.RECONCILE carries evidence_effect: 'INVALIDATE_SUBJECT_EVIDENCE'. The contract does not say the evidence survives a reconcile; it says the opposite, and the invalidation of the pass-4 attestation is what the contract predicted rather than an accident. The defect is not the rebase but the sequencing before it: AGENTS.md requires a freeze before witness evidence is used as evidence for a repository candidate, and operations.QUALIFY is available only from FROZEN and requires_exact_subject_match, so none of the four attestations taken against this MUTABLE carrier could ever have qualified it. Had the carrier been frozen before witness, the base move would have been handled by SUPERSEDE, whose evidence_effect is PRESERVE_OLD_EVIDENCE and which requires_new_candidate, followed by a fresh FREEZE: the same tree, with an explicit superseded subject instead of an orphaned SHA.

the_carrier_state_is_independently_reada.detail: It is not. sov_candidate.py exposes only show, judge and selfcheck; judge grades a state the caller asserts. No candidate or carrier state is persisted anywhere in scripts/, contracts/ or .local/. So 'the carrier is MUTABLE' is an assertion no artifact can contradict, because nothing records that a FREEZE ever occurred, and INVALIDATE_SUBJECT_EVIDENCE fires silently without naming the evidence it invalidated. That is why this orphaning had to be noticed by a person and why this record is the only artifact that will tell a reader the earlier revisions are unreachable.
